text_simplified: The statement of the Prophet ﷺ that every shepherd is responsible for his flock is a reminder that Allah will question the servant about this trust on the Day of Resurrection; indeed some scholars said a parent will be questioned about his child before the child is questioned about his parent. Responsibility between parents and children is mutual: Just as Allah commanded children to honor their parents, He commanded parents to raise their children—and His command to parents comes first. The profound influence of parents is shown in that the Prophet ﷺ informed that every newborn is born upon the fitrah and that parents have a profound impact on his religion, and he gave the example of the animal born sound, with any defect coming only from its owner.
